title: cave-viewer config
description: A cave repo's config for cave-viewer: its caves, and for each where its survey, names, ground, drawn survey and walls come from. Paths are relative to the config file's folder. Each cave is deep-merged over "defaults" (objects merge; lists and other values replace). Keys starting with _ are comments.

work.description: Where intermediate files go: <work>/<cave id>/ (cave.3d, names.json, plan.svg, esri/, credits.json). Keep it out of git if the data's licence says so.

site.description: The landing page, for a repo of several caves.

index.description: Write <out>/index.html listing the caves. Default: on for several caves, off for one.

footer.description: HTML. {credits} becomes each cave's name and credit, in turn.

defaults.description: What every cave shares; each cave is merged over it. id and name aren't required here.

station.description: A survey station's full name, as in the .3d file (e.g. GB.Crickmay.gb.z.7).

place.description: A place's name: an entrance, a label on the drawn survey, or one of the cave's places.

id.description: The cave's id: its work folder, its caches' names, its USDZ's name.

name.description: As on its page: GB Cave.

short_name.description: For the home screen. Default: the name without ' Cave' or ' Swallet'.

path.description: Where its page goes in the site: <out>/<path>/. Default: its id.

area.description: Where it is, under its name: Blackdown, Charterhouse.

credit.description: The survey's credit, HTML: on its page, the printed route card, the drawn survey's meta.json and the landing page.

data.description: The page's link to the data. Default: the Therion survey's Subversion folder.

html.description: The whole of that part of the credits, instead (e.g. a download link).

offset.description: Added to the survey's x, y for full National Grid coordinates: [300000, 100000] for a survey on the ST square, [0, 0] for one already on the full grid.

fix.description: For a survey in its own local coordinates: the whole survey moved so this station is at this place (x, y in the survey's grid square, as offset makes full, and the height).

svn.description: A Subversion URL to check out into checkout (and update on each build, unless --no-fetch). Leave out for a Therion project already in the repo.

checkout.description: The folder holding the Therion project(s).

svx.description: Survex files Therion imports, built first with cavern.

from.description: Where the drawing says it's from (with /<dir> after it): Cave Registry Data Archive, CheddarCatchment.

file.description: A names.json in the repo to start from: any of the keys below, which the cave's own config then adds to or replaces.

entrances.description: Entrance station -> name, in order (the first is the page's grid reference). Default: the stations the survey flags as entrances.

places.description: Place name -> its station: names the drawing doesn't give, or a better station for one it does.

surveys.description: Top-level survey name -> passage name, for every station in it.

codes.description: Regular expression on station names -> passage name (a passage's own survey series).

ways.description: The usual ways, each a chain of places, which routes keep to.

offway.description: How many times as far a passage off the usual ways counts.

trips.description: Ready-made routes, each a chain of places in turn (a round trip starts and ends at the same place).

avoid.description: Station -> why routes keep away from it (a leg to or from one counts as 20 times as far).

apart.description: Entrances shown but kept out of the routes (their tie into the cave provisional, say).

alone.description: Places labelled on the map that lend their name to no passage near them.

sumps.description: Top-level surveys that are sumps: routes don't dive them.

note.description: An extra line for the Therion drawing's title block.

licence.description: The licence line for the Therion drawing's title block.

routing.description: How the centreline becomes the routes' graph and its names.

duplicates.description: Duplicate legs join the graph (in some surveys they join the parts).

join.description: Metres: pieces of the survey this near another are joined (0: never).

codes_first.description: A station's code (codes) names it ahead of the nearest place; false: the nearest place first.

snap.description: Metres: an entrance further than this from the surveyed cave can't be routed to.

type.description: ea: the Environment Agency's 1 m LiDAR composite DTM (England). wales: the Welsh Government's 1 m LiDAR DTM 2020-22. flat: no LiDAR, a level ground just above the cave.

step.description: Metres between the model's ground samples (a multiple of the 1 m LiDAR).

margin.description: Metres of ground round the cave.

align.description: The ground's edges on a grid of this many metres.

cache.description: Where fetched LiDAR is kept, averaged (null: not kept).

level.description: flat: the ground's height (default 10 m above the cave's top).

credit.description: The ground's credit on the page, HTML (default: the source's own).

drawn.description: The drawn survey, for the 2D plan.

type.description: A plan Therion has drawn, with a title block: the one the survey step draws (a Therion survey), or drawn.svg.

svg.description: A plan the repo's own Therion build has drawn (export map -fmt svg), for any survey type. Its layout needs the grid's coordinates on it, to place it: grid bottom and grid-coords border.

credit.description: For its meta.json (default: the cave's credit).

page_credit.description: Its credit on the page, HTML.

type.description: A scanned drawing, fitted to the survey by python -m caveviewer fit.

image.description: The drawing. Without it the build makes no drawn survey, so a private drawing kept out of git is only ever in a local build.

fit.description: The fit (JSON), written by python -m caveviewer fit.

type.description: Walls built by Therion from a Therion survey's drawings, not from its splays: the survey step exports them to <work>/<cave>/walls.lox.

lox.description: A Therion .lox file with the passage walls, already in the repo.

heights.description: survey (the default for walls from the drawings): walls more than 3 m above or below their leg are put back on it, and roofs and floors are pushed out to reach the splays at its stations. lox (the default for a .lox in the repo): the walls as they are.

max_step.description: Metres: wall triangles taller than this and much taller than they are wide are left out, as curtains Therion draws between passages at different levels in one drawing. Off by default: it also leaves holes where a passage really does step down.

walls.description: Passage walls, where there are any: {"type": "therion"} for walls from a Therion survey's drawings, or {"lox": path} for a .lox in the repo.

kml.description: A Therion KML export: the imagery is nudged so the entrance lands where it says (OSTN15).

features.description: The page's features, all on unless turned off.

directions.description: The route's written directions (each step's text, the list of steps and the printable card). Off: the route, its height profile and Back and Next, with more room for the cave.

ar.description: View in AR (USDZ, on an iPhone or iPad).

offline.description: The service worker that keeps the page for use with no signal.
